use_cases.name: Report, investigate and close a safety incident
use_cases.goal: Record incidents and near-misses at a site, investigate root cause, track corrective actions and prepare statutory accident notices within the required time (to be validated by Legal).

stakeholders.interest: Can report hazards and injuries easily and without fear of blame.
Notifiable accidents are notified within the statutory window with evidence retained.
Sees incident trends and closure of corrective actions per site.

use_cases.trigger: An employee or supervisor reports an injury, dangerous occurrence or near-miss.
preconditions: Incident categories, severity levels and the notifiability criteria per state rule pack are configured.
The EHS sub-function (OU-180) is set up with an investigator role per site.
postconditions_success: The incident is recorded with severity, root cause and corrective actions closed; any statutory notice is prepared, filed by a human and its acknowledgement retained.
postconditions_failure: An overdue notice or open corrective action is escalated to the compliance owner and site head.

main_flow.action: Reports an incident from the mobile app: hand injury at the Medchal Works press line on 2026-11-03 at 14:20, with photos.
Confirms the report, records first aid given and classifies severity as lost-time injury.
Evaluates notifiability against the state rule pack and, if notifiable, creates an obligation with its due time.
Links the injured person's absence days to the incident so the lost-time count is derived.
Reviews the prepared accident notice, assembled from the incident record.
Files the notice on the statutory portal and records the acknowledgement reference.
Leads the root-cause investigation and records causes and corrective actions with owners and due dates.
Tracks corrective actions, sends reminders and escalates overdue items.
Verifies the actions are effective and closes the incident.

alternate_flows.condition: The event is a near-miss with no injury.
steps: The near-miss is recorded with hazard category; no notifiability check is needed.

alternate_flows.condition: The reporter chooses to remain anonymous for a hazard report.
steps: The report is stored without reporter identity and routed to the site EHS lead.

exception_flows.condition: The statutory notice is not filed before its due time.
exception_flows.handling: The obligation is escalated to the compliance owner and site head as overdue, with the delay recorded.

exception_flows.condition: No state rule pack version covers the site's state on the incident date.
exception_flows.handling: The incident is flagged for manual notifiability assessment by the compliance owner.

nfrs: An incident report can be submitted from a mobile device on a 3G connection in under 60 s.
Incident records and filed notices are retained for the statutory retention period (to be validated by Legal).

user_stories.want: to report an injury or hazard from my phone with photos
user_stories.so_that: it is recorded immediately and action starts

acceptance.given: I am at Medchal Works line 2
acceptance.when: I report a hand injury with two photos at 14:20
acceptance.then: the incident is created with site, line and time and my supervisor is notified

acceptance.given: I report a hazard anonymously
acceptance.then: no identity is stored and the site EHS lead receives it

user_stories.want: a notice prepared from the incident record with its due time
user_stories.so_that: notifiable accidents are filed on time

acceptance.given: a lost-time injury classified as notifiable under the Telangana pack
acceptance.then: an obligation is created with its due time and a prepared notice

acceptance.given: the notice is filed with acknowledgement reference TS-ACC-88213
acceptance.then: the obligation closes and the reference is kept against the incident

user_stories.want: corrective actions tracked to closure with reminders

acceptance.given: an action 'install light curtain on press 4' due 2026-11-20
acceptance.when: the due date passes without closure
acceptance.then: the action is escalated to the site head

acceptance.given: all actions are verified
acceptance.when: the compliance owner closes the incident
acceptance.then: the incident shows closed with the verification date

use_cases.name: Raise and handle a grievance or protected disclosure
use_cases.goal: Let employees raise grievances and protected disclosures, anonymously if they choose, with confidential case handling, escalation timelines and outcome reporting.

stakeholders.interest: Can raise a concern safely and follow its progress without revealing identity.
Serious disclosures reach the right committee without being filtered by line management.
Cases are handled within timelines and outcomes are reported.

use_cases.trigger: An employee submits a grievance or a protected disclosure through the confidential channel.
preconditions: Case categories, handling committees and escalation timelines are configured per entity.
Case data is restricted to the assigned handlers; managers named in a case are excluded from its access.
postconditions_success: The case is investigated and closed with an outcome; the reporter is informed through the case channel and aggregated outcomes appear in periodic reports.
postconditions_failure: An overdue case escalates to the next level; no case is closed without a recorded outcome.

main_flow.action: Opens the confidential channel, chooses 'protected disclosure', selects anonymous and describes the concern.
Creates the case, issues a case key for the reporter and strips identifying metadata from the submission.
Routes the case to the handling committee for the category and excludes any person named in it from access.
Acknowledges the case and records an initial assessment within the configured timeline.
Investigates, exchanging messages with the reporter through the case key without learning their identity.
Reviews findings and decides the outcome and any action.
Closes the case, informs the reporter of the outcome category and adds it to aggregated outcome reports.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee raises a named grievance about working conditions.
steps: The case is routed to HR operations under the grievance timeline and the employee is kept informed by name.
A separate disciplinary case is opened with restricted access, linked to this case.

exception_flows.condition: The case is not acknowledged within the timeline.
exception_flows.handling: It escalates automatically to the next committee level and the delay is recorded.

exception_flows.condition: A handler is named in the case.
exception_flows.handling: That handler is removed from access and the case is reassigned.

nfrs: Anonymous submissions store no IP address, device identifier or account link.
Every access to a case record is logged and visible to the committee chair.

user_stories.want: to raise a concern anonymously and still follow its progress
user_stories.so_that: I can speak up without fear of retaliation

acceptance.given: I submit an anonymous disclosure about falsified inspection records at Chakan Works
acceptance.then: I receive a case key and no identity is stored

acceptance.given: the investigator posts a question
acceptance.when: I log in with my case key
acceptance.then: I can read and reply without revealing my identity

user_stories.want: people named in a case excluded from its access

acceptance.given: a disclosure naming Peenya plant head E1016
acceptance.then: E1016 has no access to the case even though E1016 holds HR scope at the site

acceptance.given: the case is not acknowledged within 7 days
acceptance.then: it escalates to the committee chair

user_stories.want: aggregated grievance outcomes by category and site
user_stories.so_that: I can see patterns without exposing individuals

acceptance.given: 12 closed cases in Q3 2026
acceptance.then: counts by category, site and outcome are shown with no reporter details

acceptance.given: a site with fewer than 3 cases in a category
acceptance.then: that cell is combined into 'other' to avoid identification

use_cases.name: Track and renew licences and registrations
use_cases.goal: Track factory licences, establishment registrations and contractor licences with expiry alerts and a renewal workflow.

stakeholders.interest: No site operates on an expired licence.
Knows well in advance which documents are needed for renewal.
Renewal fees are planned and paid on time.

use_cases.trigger: A licence or registration approaches its expiry date, or a new one is issued.
preconditions: Licences are recorded per location and entity with number, issuing authority, validity dates and owner, for example factory licence KA/FAC/2013/00891 for Peenya Works.
Contractor licences are linked to the vendor and the principal-employer location.
postconditions_success: The renewed licence is recorded with its new validity and acknowledgement, and the old version is end-dated.
postconditions_failure: An unrenewed licence is escalated, and dependent activities such as onboarding a contractor's workers are flagged.

main_flow.action: Detects that the Peenya Works factory licence expires within 90 days and opens a renewal obligation.
Alerts the compliance owner and Peenya plant HR with the checklist of required documents.
Uploads the required documents, such as the updated manpower statement, to the renewal case.
Prepares the renewal pack from posted records, including headcount by worker class at the site.
Approves the renewal application and fee.
Files the application on the statutory portal and records the acknowledgement.
Records the renewed licence with its new validity when issued.
Writes the new licence version, end-dates the old one and closes the obligation.

alternate_flows.condition: The licence is a contractor licence held by vendor VN-01.
steps: The vendor is asked to upload the renewed licence; the compliance owner verifies it.

exception_flows.condition: The licence expires before renewal is recorded.
exception_flows.handling: The licence is shown as expired, escalated to the director and, for a contractor licence, new deployments of that contractor's workers are blocked.

exception_flows.condition: Headcount in the renewal pack exceeds the licensed capacity.
exception_flows.handling: The pack is flagged and the compliance owner must address the variance before filing.

nfrs: Expiry alerts are sent at 90, 60, 30 and 7 days before expiry.
The licence register for all five sites loads in under 2 s.

user_stories.want: alerts well before any licence expires
user_stories.so_that: no site ever operates on an expired licence

acceptance.given: the Chakan Works factory licence MH/FAC/2015/03327 expires on 2026-12-31
acceptance.then: a renewal obligation is opened and I am alerted

acceptance.given: the renewed licence is recorded with validity to 2027-12-31
acceptance.then: the old version is end-dated and the obligation closes

user_stories.want: a renewal pack built from posted headcount
user_stories.so_that: the figures in the application match our records

acceptance.given: Peenya Works has 23 permanent, 2 trainee and 5 third-party workers posted
acceptance.then: the manpower statement shows those counts

acceptance.given: headcount above the licensed capacity
acceptance.then: the variance is flagged before filing

user_stories.want: contractor deployments blocked when the contractor's licence has expired
user_stories.so_that: we are not exposed as principal employer

acceptance.given: vendor VN-01's licence expired on 2026-10-31
acceptance.when: HR tries to deploy a new VN-01 worker on 2026-11-02
acceptance.then: deployment is blocked with the expired licence named

acceptance.given: VN-01 uploads a renewed licence
acceptance.then: deployments are unblocked

use_cases.name: Record inspection visits and close resulting orders
use_cases.goal: Record statutory inspection visits, remarks and orders at a site and track the resulting compliance actions to closure.

stakeholders.interest: Every inspector's remark and order is answered within its deadline.
Sees open inspection actions across sites.
Has a complete inspection history per site.

use_cases.trigger: An inspector visits a site, for example a factory inspection at Oragadam Works.
preconditions: The site's statutory registers and forms are generated from posted records (RL-380).
Inspection types and response deadlines are configured.
postconditions_success: The visit, remarks and orders are recorded; each order's actions are closed with evidence and the compliance report is filed.
postconditions_failure: Open actions past their deadline are escalated to the compliance owner and director.

main_flow.action: Records the visit: date, inspector designation, authority, scope and registers inspected.
Shows the registers and forms generated for the site and period so they can be produced at once.
Records the inspector's remarks and any written orders, attaching a scan of the inspection-book entry.
Converts each order into actions with owners and deadlines.
Completes assigned actions and uploads evidence, such as a corrected muster roll.
Prepares and files the compliance report and records the acknowledgement.
Closes the visit when all actions are verified and the report acknowledgement is recorded.

alternate_flows.condition: The inspection results in no remarks.
steps: The visit is recorded as 'no remarks' and closed.

exception_flows.handling: It is escalated to the compliance owner and site head.

exception_flows.condition: A register required by the inspector cannot be generated because source records are missing.
exception_flows.handling: The gap is listed and an action is created to correct it.

nfrs: Any statutory register for a site and month is produced in under 30 s during a visit.
Inspection history is retained per site for at least the statutory retention period (to be validated by Legal).
use_cases.frequency: Several times a year per site

user_stories.want: registers for the site produced instantly during an inspection
user_stories.so_that: the inspector sees accurate records without delay

acceptance.given: an inspector at Oragadam Works asks for the October 2026 muster roll
acceptance.then: the register for LOC-CHN and October is produced from posted records

acceptance.given: records for two workers are incomplete
acceptance.then: the gaps are listed and an action is created

user_stories.want: each order turned into tracked actions with deadlines
user_stories.so_that: nothing an inspector asks for is missed

acceptance.given: an order to display the abstract of the Act in Tamil within 15 days
acceptance.then: an action due 2026-11-19 is assigned to the site HR

acceptance.given: the action is overdue
acceptance.then: it is escalated to me and the site head

user_stories.want: open inspection actions across all sites
user_stories.so_that: I can see where we are exposed

acceptance.given: 3 open actions at Oragadam and 1 at Medchal
acceptance.then: I see 4 open actions with sites and due dates

acceptance.given: all actions for a visit are verified and the report is filed
acceptance.then: the visit no longer appears as open
